blocks.text: Wooden walkway and pavilion on the mountain slopes of Cotopaxi National Park, Ecuador
Cotopaxi, Ecuador: a walking path beside grassy mountain slopes

After breakfast, take a tour of Baños and follow the waterfall route. The day lasts about 8 hours, including transfers. The drive from Baños to Quito takes approximately 3 hours.

Baños sits at 1,826 m in a valley below the 5,016 m Tungurahua volcano. The town has around 20,000 residents and an average annual temperature of about 20 °C. It is known for its waterfalls, hot springs and outdoor activities, including rafting, rock climbing, canyoning, zip-lining, trekking, mountain biking and bungee jumping.

Start in the town centre before following the waterfall route to Agoyán, Manto de la Novia (Bridal Veil) and Pailón del Diablo (Devil's Cauldron). The programme also includes the famous Swing at the End of the World.

An optional zip-line ride over the Pastaza Canyon costs USD 15 per person, payable separately.

The main stops are the Swing at the End of the World, Agoyán Waterfall, a walk along the canyon, Manto de la Novia Waterfall with a cable car ride, Pailón del Diablo and a short tour of Baños.

After the tour, transfer to Quito.

**Accommodation:** Plaza Grande 5*, Royal Suite.  
**Meals:** breakfast.
